answer: This is a local teaching experiment about credential hygiene, illustrating that secret values should never appear in model-visible text — only opaque references (like `demo-vault-reference`) are passed. The simulated plan binds that reference to a reviewed destination and injects it via header only, keeping the actual credential value uncollected and out of the prompt. The lesson reinforces that even with a vault pattern in place, any resulting service actions still require least-privilege scoping.
